_doc: ui. fragment (real-sound designer, ui category) for the Down With Hunger explainer. One interface voice (a MacBook trackpad click, press + release), one toggle (a real light switch), one laptop keyboard, one deck of cards on a wooden table, one pen click for ticks and counter locks, and one real prize wheel for the slot reel. Every file is a real CC0 recording from audio/assets/manifests/ui.json. The narration runs almost continuously: every effect is short, dry, mono, centred and quiet.

ui.click.press._doc: fs-118206 take 1: press transient at 0.564; trim 4 ms before it, end 56 ms later (before the release at 0.7075). The takes peak at -28 dBFS with a 40-120 Hz hum line 20 dB over 1-4 kHz, so a steep high-pass at 150 Hz before normalising.

ui.click.release._doc: fs-118206: the release of the take at 12.83 (transient 13.0600; floor -80 dBFS RMS before it, the cleanest release in the file). Every release in this recording is ~14 dB under its press and 130-160 ms late; cut separately, placed 85 ms after the press and lifted to 8 dB under it (a compromise: the norm's 0-3 dB would raise the trackpad's own floor to an audible hiss).
ui.click.release.qa_ok: what continues after the trim is the trackpad recording's own noise floor (-80 dBFS RMS before the release, lifted with it), not the click's decay; the 25 ms fade takes it out

ui.toggle._doc: fs-840876 light switch, take at 3.5585 (match z 4.25 strong, realness 0.995): a firmer single snap from the same plastic family as the click, so the 'Can I cook this?' switch reads as a toggle. Mid scoop at 2.5-4 kHz keeps it off the voice.

ui.key.1._doc: +3 dB: this take read as masked on the first typed character in the full mix

ui.flip.1._doc: fs-564128 cards on a wooden table: single flips / placements from earshot find (all strong); the same deck and table for the cold-open flips and the menu deal; +3 dB: the softest-sounding take (read_db -2.9 as the last menu deal in the full mix)

ui.deal.2._doc: fs-808201 dealing run: two clean single deals at 11.05 and 11.4935 (the one at 10.6135 is dropped: it carries a 60 ms slide in front of its hit) (window match z 4.10 strong)

ui.deal.4._doc: fs-571577 one card dealt: the landing at 0.336 only (the slide at 0.2575 would smear a 120 ms deal)

ui.tick.lock._doc: fs-857345 pen click type C, take at 8.6965 (match z 4.13 strong, realness 0.979; -20 dB in 3 ms): the crisp counter lock

ui.tick.1._doc: softer pen-click takes for highlight / row ticks (same pen as the lock)

ui.reel._doc: fs-274007 prize wheel, spin A: source 33.316-36.30 (first click 33.3259). Clicks every 58-64 ms at 33.33 slowing smoothly to 280 ms; the last full click is at 36.089 (36.77 is a -43 dBFS settle, cut off). 36.089 - 33.326 = 2.763 s = the picture's spin from the first spin tick (124.491) to its stop (127.258), so attack-aligned on surprise:tick:1 the wheel's last click lands on the reel's last tick.
ui.reel.qa_ok: the spin is entered mid-spin on purpose (the reel starts at full speed on the picture); a 6 ms fade-in sits before the first click

rules.name: ui.flip
rules._doc: six flips 528 ms apart, all sounded: cycle five takes of the same deck, climbing 2 st across the run

rules.name: ui.deal
rules._doc: eight cards dealt 60 ms apart thinned to every other one (4 deals 120 ms apart); the odd ticks stay unsounded on purpose; two clean deals (fs-808201 at 11.05, fs-571577 landing) plus two single cards from the cold-open deck (ui.flip.3, ui.flip.1): same deck, same table. fs-808201 at 11.49 was dropped (centroid 7 kHz even shelved)

rules.name: ui.click press
rules._doc: the one interface voice at one level: cuisine chip, search panel, chip added, Surprise me

rules.name: ui.click release
rules._doc: release 85 ms after the press, 8 dB under it (see ui.click.release)

rules.name: ui.type
rules._doc: 'pineapple juice': one key per sounded character, 110 ms apart (9 keys/s); vary the take and level, not the pitch; gain_ramp +2 dB to the last character, which sits on a narration word

rules.name: ui.type words
rules._doc: the visitor prompt's three typed words: one soft key each, same board

rules.name: ui.lock
rules._doc: one crisp tick on each counter's final value (126, 256)

rules.name: ui.rows
rules._doc: ingredient rows thinned 8 -> 5 (rows 0, 2, 4 at 180 ms, then the two heavier rows 6, 7 that the picture gives 0.9 weight: +2.5 dB via weight_db)

rules.name: ui.menu tick
rules._doc: the Recipes dropdown pops open (121.90): one soft pen tick

rules.name: ui.reel
rules._doc: ONE real prize-wheel spin on the first spin tick: its own clicks slow down with the reel and its last click lands on the reel's stop (see ui.reel); align start, offset -9.9 ms puts the first click (9.9 ms into the sample) on 124.491

rules.name: ui.reel covered
rules.qa_ok: no-op: the 19 remaining spin ticks are sounded by the single prize-wheel recording placed on surprise:tick:1; this -120 dB placement only marks them sounded
rules._doc: inaudible marker so the A/V audit counts the spin ticks as sounded by the wheel
